# Prime Logicx

> Prime Logicx is a remote-first digital solutions company offering three core services: web and app development (including Shopify), AI automation solutions, and digital marketing/SEO — delivered by one team for clients worldwide.

## Services
- Web & App Development: custom Shopify stores, web applications (React/Next.js/Node.js), mobile apps, API integrations
- AI & Automation Solutions: custom AI chatbots, workflow automation, LLM integrations, internal tooling
- Digital Marketing & SEO: technical/on-page SEO, content strategy, paid social/search advertising, analytics setup
